Inline enum values:

#### `rdt_revision_12_5_mode`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `legacy_rev_12_4_behavior` | RDT behaves per Rev 12.4 |
| 0x01 | `rev_12_5_behavior` | RDT behaves per Rev 12.5 |

#### `rdt_auto_mode`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `manual` | Host controls RDT value through byte 131 |
| 0x01 | `automatic` | Module control loop controls RDT |
